program.name: Posterior Chain
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Glute and hamstring emphasis with slow lowering and pauses.
program.about: Glute and hamstring emphasis, with slow lowering and pauses. The cycle runs a hinge day, a glute day and an upper-body day, in straight sets. Level II slows every lowering to three seconds and Level III moves you one weight up. Good for your back, your sprint and how you stand.
